mapper.update: MERGE INTO daily_ohlcv t USING (SELECT #{symbol} symbol, #{tradeDate} trade_date FROM dual) s ON (t.symbol = s.symbol AND t.trade_date = s.trade_date) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET open_p = #{openP}, high_p = #{highP}, low_p = #{lowP}, close_p = #{closeP}, volume = #{volume} WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (symbol, trade_date, open_p, high_p, low_p, close_p, volume) VALUES (#{symbol}, #{tradeDate}, #{openP}, #{highP}, #{lowP}, #{closeP}, #{volume})
mapper.select: SELECT d.symbol AS symbol, u.name AS name, u.market AS market, u.sector AS sector, d.close_p AS lastPrice, d.volume AS volume FROM daily_ohlcv d JOIN (SELECT MAX(trade_date) md FROM daily_ohlcv) m ON d.trade_date = m.md LEFT JOIN universe u ON u.symbol = d.symbol ORDER BY d.volume DESC NULLS LAST FETCH FIRST #{n} ROWS ONLY
SELECT symbol AS symbol, close_p AS closeP FROM daily_ohlcv WHERE trade_date = (SELECT MAX(trade_date) FROM daily_ohlcv WHERE trade_date < #{latest})

WITH w AS ( SELECT d.symbol, d.high_p, d.low_p, d.close_p, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.symbol ORDER BY d.trade_date DESC) rn FROM daily_ohlcv d JOIN universe u ON u.symbol = d.symbol WHERE d.trade_date >= #{fromDate} AND d.high_p IS NOT NULL AND d.low_p IS NOT NULL AND d.close_p IS NOT NULL ) SELECT symbol AS symbol, COUNT(*) AS bar_count, MAX(high_p) AS max_high, MIN(low_p) AS min_low, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN close_p END) AS last_close, AVG(CASE WHEN rn > FLOOR(#{windowBars} / 2) THEN close_p END) AS first_half_avg_close, AVG(CASE WHEN rn <= FLOOR(#{windowBars} / 2) THEN close_p END) AS second_half_avg_close FROM w WHERE rn <= #{windowBars} GROUP BY symbol HAVING COUNT(*) >= #{windowBars} ORDER BY symbol

WITH mkt AS (
SELECT symbol FROM us_universe
SELECT symbol FROM universe
), covered AS ( SELECT d.trade_date FROM daily_ohlcv d JOIN mkt m ON m.symbol = d.symbol GROUP BY d.trade_date HAVING COUNT(*) >= #{minCoverage} ), ref AS (SELECT MAX(trade_date) d FROM covered), prv AS (SELECT MAX(trade_date) d FROM covered WHERE trade_date < (SELECT d FROM ref)), agg AS ( SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN t.close_p > p.close_p THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS up, COUNT(*) AS total FROM daily_ohlcv t JOIN mkt m ON m.symbol = t.symbol JOIN daily_ohlcv p ON p.symbol = t.symbol WHERE t.trade_date = (SELECT d FROM ref) AND p.trade_date = (SELECT d FROM prv) ) SELECT TO_CHAR((SELECT d FROM ref), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS ref_date, TO_CHAR((SELECT d FROM prv), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS prev_date, up, total FROM agg

WITH w AS ( SELECT u.sector AS sector, d.symbol AS symbol, FIRST_VALUE(d.close_p) OVER (PARTITION BY d.symbol ORDER BY d.trade_date) AS first_close, LAST_VALUE(d.close_p) OVER (PARTITION BY d.symbol ORDER BY d.trade_date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS last_close FROM daily_ohlcv d JOIN universe u ON u.symbol = d.symbol WHERE d.trade_date >= #{since} AND u.sector IS NOT NULL AND d.close_p IS NOT NULL ), per_symbol AS ( SELECT sector, symbol, MAX(first_close) AS fc, MAX(last_close) AS lc, COUNT(*) AS bars FROM w GROUP BY sector, symbol ) SELECT sector, ROUND(AVG((lc - fc) / fc * 100), 2) AS return_pct, COUNT(*) AS symbols FROM per_symbol WHERE fc > 0 AND bars >= #{minBars} GROUP BY sector HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3 ORDER BY 2 DESC
